image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront featuring a large, curved glass display window filled with baked goods on illuminated shelves. To the left is an open entrance door with posted notices. Above the window is a white sign with stylized text and a blue grid graphic. The facade includes beige paneling and some graffiti on the upper wall. The interior is warmly lit, showcasing golden-brown breads and pastries.
